responsibility: Implements the compiler-side management of gcov coverage data files and emitted metadata objects. This file reads existing .gcda counts for profile-use, writes .gcno notes records for test coverage, allocates per-function/per-counter variables, tracks function identifiers and CFG/line checksums, and builds the static gcov_info/gcov_fn_info objects and registration/constructor machinery that the generated program or libgcov runtime uses. It is the central file-level coordinator between GCC’s instrumentation passes and the gcov on-disk format, including path mangling, output file naming, and finalization of per-translation-unit coverage data.
same_name_distinction: This source file is the implementation of the compiler-side coverage manager declared by gcc/coverage.h. It actually reads .gcda counts, writes .gcno notes, allocates per-function counters, builds gcov_info/gcov_fn_info objects and registration code, and handles output-path naming and finalization; the header only exposes those services to the rest of GCC.
